title: Piano_roll_game
tagline: A side-scrolling game you play with a piano's MIDI input, turning your notes into color, motion and speed.
lead: Piano_roll_game is a side-scrolling game that you control by playing a piano. It reads the piano's MIDI input and links it to color, movement and speed on screen. MIDI is a standard way for electronic instruments to send note information to a computer.

sections.heading: What it does
paragraphs: You play a piano, and the game turns your playing into what happens on screen. Your notes affect the color, the motion and the speed of the game. The game has two courses.
bullets: Free play course: you play freely, so you can also use it to compose music.

Set song course: obstacles are placed to follow a song's velocity and sustain. Velocity means how hard a key is pressed. Sustain means how long a note is held. This course can also play the song back as an example.
Playing the set song course can turn into improvisation without you planning it.

sections.heading: How it works
paragraphs: The system has five parts. They handle MIDI input, game movement, drawing the screen, sound effects, and the song courses.

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: The idea for this MIDI-controlled game came from the Casio MT.
